named-native-query.name: EsqOrgJpa.detailOrg
named-native-query.query: SELECT org_pk as "pk" ,org_et_pk as "kind" ,org_name as "name" ,org_desc as "desc" ,org_full_name FROM esq_org WHERE org_pk = :id AND org_path LIKE :rootPath || '%'

named-native-query.name: EsqUsrJpa.detailUsr
named-native-query.query: SELECT usr_pk as "pk" ,usr_et_pk as "kind" ,usr_name as "name" ,usr_desc as "desc" ,au_login_id ,usr_reg_option ,usr_deleted_flg ,au_email FROM esq_user, esq_auth WHERE usr_pk = :id AND usr_pk = au_usr_pk AND usr_path LIKE :rootPath || '%'

named-native-query.name: EsqUsrJpa.userAccts
named-native-query.query: SELECT acc_pk ,acc_id ,acc_et_pk ,acc_desc FROM esq_account WHERE acc_usr_pk = :id AND acc_path LIKE :rootPath || '%'

named-native-query.name: EsqOrgJpa.detailOrgForUpdate
named-native-query.query: SELECT org_pk as "pk" ,org_et_pk as "kind" ,org_name as "name" ,org_desc as "desc" ,org_full_name FROM esq_org WHERE org_pk = :id AND org_path LIKE :rootPath || '%' FOR UPDATE

named-native-query.name: EsqUsrJpa.detailUsrForUpdate
named-native-query.query: SELECT usr_pk as "pk" ,usr_et_pk as "kind" ,usr_name as "name" ,usr_desc as "desc" ,au_login_id ,usr_reg_option ,usr_deleted_flg ,au_email FROM esq_user, esq_auth WHERE usr_pk = :id AND usr_pk = au_usr_pk AND usr_path LIKE :rootPath || '%' FOR UPDATE OF usr_pk

named-native-query.name: EsqOrgJpa.updateOrg
named-native-query.query: UPDATE esq_org SET org_name = :name ,org_desc = :desc ,org_full_name = :fullName WHERE org_pk = :id

named-native-query.name: EsqUsrJpa.updateUsr
named-native-query.query: UPDATE esq_user SET usr_name = :name ,usr_desc = :desc ,usr_reg_option = :registration ,usr_deleted_flg = :deleted WHERE usr_pk = :id

named-native-query.name: EsqUsrJpa.updateAuth
named-native-query.query: UPDATE esq_auth SET au_email = :email WHERE au_usr_pk = :id
